capabilities: Surface notes from the same date in previous years
Switch between outline and snippet view modes
Detect note dates from frontmatter, filename, or creation time
Exclude folders from the history search
Customize card fonts, colors, and hover effects
disambiguation: Not a Canvas (visual board) plugin; it is a sidebar view that resurfaces past notes by date.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; README is bilingual (English and Chinese).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to revisit notes from the same month and day in previous years, so past journal entries and dated notes stay buried.
summary: Sidebar view that surfaces notes written on this day in previous years as collapsible cards with outline or snippet previews.
